about_the_game:
*This demo includes two levels from the full game!

  • Green Ruins: An open level where you can explore and complete several missions!

  • Null Dimension 01: A linear challenge level to get through as fas as you can an get the best rank possible!

    In this demo all gadgets are unlocked, so had fun since the beggining!

Inspired by 90's and 2000's 3D platformers, Cosmo Vulpes is a sci-fi adventure where your main tool is the jetpack. Play as bounty hunter fox called Klaus, with his jetpack and others gadgets developed by his friend Safira, a brilliant and skilled mechanic, you will help him to pass through challenges and missions on this adventure, earning money and collecting Vultechs, which are a big source of energy, but he is not the only one looking for them!

   Energy is something extremely valuable, a bounty hunter fox called Klaus together with his long time friend Safira are broke! Now they need explore the galaxy looking for missions and rewards to pay their bills, collecting Energy Gears and the Vultech Crystals, a powerful source of energy!

   Seems like a company who hires bounty-hunters announced a big reward for the bounty-hunter group who stays at the first of the rank at the end of the season, this is a big opportunity right?

   Combine Klaus' agility and skills with all the tools provided by the little fox, mainly the jetpack, while she do all the tech work and assistence!

  • A jetpack that can make you fly through the levels! (this one it's obvious at this point) Get through large distances and higher grounds with this item that is almost a extension of Klaus' body!

  • Expressive movement and platforming! Use your jetpack and gadgets the way you want, chain them, make awesome moves and traverse the levels how you like it!

  • 5 Rivals to face off! Being a bounty hunter it's not easy, face this rivals and show that you really need to pay your bills!

  • Stylized characters! Meet several stylized characters in these colorful worlds, even though not everyone is so friendly.

  • Challenge levels to test your skill and speed! How fast can you beat theses levels? And what rank did you get on them? Try your best to get the hidden rank SS!
